response.opening: Dr. Meera, a DCI regulation change takes effect on Tuesday, 15 Dec 2026, so your radiograph setup needs a quick review.
response.detail: The DCI circular dated 4 Nov 2026 lowers the maximum IOPA exposure from 1.5 mSv to 1.0 mSv; E-speed film and digital RVG are unaffected, while D-speed does not meet the new limit. I can prepare a concise checklist covering the audit and SOP documentation.
response.ask: Would you like me to draft it? Reply YES.
response.rationale: Uses the DCI deadline, dose limits, film and RVG details; highlights compliance risk and offers an effort-saving checklist.
